_comment: One manifest, two clients. The browser installer reads imageUrl (a raw system image it flashes over fastboot); CircleUpdateService on the phone reads payloadUrl (an A/B payload it hands to update_engine). They are different artifacts for different mechanisms and both belong here, so neither client has to know about the other. Written by tools/publish-release.sh in the CircleOS repo. Served raw from GitHub, which sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * - the release assets do NOT, which is why imageUrl points at R2.
